blocks.text: Polymers bohat bare molecules hain jo bohat se chhote molecules ko jor kar bante hain. In chhote molecules ko monomers kehte hain, aur jorne ke amal ko polymerisation kehte hain. Organic polymers aaj kal ke bohat ahem materials hain. In ki achhi properties (khasiyat) aur kam qeemat ki wajah se hamari zindagi aasan, behtar aur sasti ho gayi hai. Polymers rozana zindagi mein har jagah nazar aate hain: shopping bags (poly(ethene)), kapre sukhane ki rassi (poly(propene)), bulletproof jackets ka plastic (Kevlar®) aur aerospace (hawai jahaz aur khala ki sanat) ke kaam, jaise Figure 26.1 mein.

Polymers ki properties is baat par munhasir (depend) hain ke polymer mein kis qism ke aur kitne monomers hain, aur polymer kis tareeqe se banaya gaya. Kuch polymers bohat halke aur naram hote hain; yeh wahan kaam aate hain jahan naram material chahiye. Kuch sakht hote hain aur garmi mein bhi mazboot rehte hain (thermally stable); yeh sakht aur der tak chalne wale (durable) materials ke tor par use hote hain. Upar ki misalon mein poly(ethene) aur poly(propene) halke aur naram hain, jab ke Kevlar® sakht hai aur bulletproof jackets ke liye munasib hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein: polymers ke systematic naam
blocks.text: Synthetic (insan ke banaye hue) polymers ka systematic naam monomer ke naam se pehle “poly” laga kar rakha jata hai. Maslan polythene ka systematic naam poly(ethene) hai aur polyvinylchloride ka poly(chloroethene). Do ya zyada monomers wale polymers ke liye aam (common) naam use hote hain, kyun ke systematic naam bohat lamba ho jata hai. Isi liye poly(ethane-1,2-diyl benzene-1,4-dicarboxylate) ko aam tor par polyethylene terephthalate, yani PETE, kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Chloroethene se bane polymer ka systematic naam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Poly(chloroethene); is ka aam naam polyvinyl chloride (PVC) hai.

items: Polymers: bohat se chhote monomers ke jurne se bane bohat bare molecules.
Properties monomers ki qism, tadaad aur banane ke tareeqe par munhasir hain.
Naam: “poly” + monomer ka naam; lambe naamon ki jagah aam naam (PETE).
